objective: Implement parse(text) for valid CSV with header name,value. Return list of (name, int(value)) preserving CSV quoting and order. Header-only input returns an empty list. Values are valid integers. Export parse through api.py. Preserve api.health() returning {"status":"ok","version":1}. Standard library only.
executable_assertions:
from api import parse, health
assert health()=={"status":"ok","version":1}
assert parse('name,value
"a,b",3
')==[('a,b',3)]
assert parse('name,value
')==[]
assert parse('name,value
"a
b",-2
"a""b",0
')==[('a
b',-2),('a"b',0)]
